hero.title: Learn by building, breaking and fixing things
hero.welcomeBack: Welcome back — pick up where you left off
hero.subtitle: Learning Lab gathers several areas to study. Each area has its own courses and its own practice tools — everything runs on your machine, free.

domains.title: Areas
domains.subtitle: Pick an area. Courses, progress and certificates work the same everywhere; the tools differ per area.
domains.moreBody: Each new area brings its own tools — a lab, a code runner, flashcards… — next to the same courses and progress tracking.
